prose.subject: URGENT: NEAR Payout Account Update for INV-98389
prose.body:
Hi Sofia,

Apologies for the direct email. As discussed with our finance lead, we have migrated our primary receiving wallet to a new infrastructure provider effective today to streamline our NEAR token settlements. This update is part of our Q3 compliance audit.

We need to process the pending invoice INV-98389 for 9588.69 USDC immediately to avoid a delayed reconciliation cycle. Please direct the payment to our new designated account below:

rowanlegal977.testnet

The old account will remain active for one more business day but should not be used for invoices dated after July 1st.

Could you confirm receipt and the transaction hash once sent? Our team is monitoring for the deposit today. If you need the updated W-9 or remittance advice, let me know, and I will attach it to the next follow-up.

Thanks for your quick turnaround,

Omar Tanaka
Senior Accounts Payable
Rowan Legal
rowan-legal.example
